name: Source loading
goal: In my products and devlogs, I have various sources: images, APA styled literature sources, videos, and documents. To display these correctly, I must create source loaders and formats to extract them from the json file and convert them into text.

approach.text: The first step is to recognize the sources. I do this by adding 2 brackets on either side of the source. To identify what source needs to be loaded, I specify the type after the first brackets. Finally I add the source itself before the closing brackets: this can be a link to a YouTube video, a path to a file for images or documents, or the source for literature. This is an example:<<image ExampleSource.png>>
